name: sitemapUrl
label: Sitemap URL
help: Enter the full URL of your website's XML sitemap or sitemap index (e.g. https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml). Every page it lists is imported, and the website's origin is taken from its host.

pattern.message: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://

name: maxPages
label: Maximum pages
help: The most pages to import from the sitemap, not counting key pages. Large sites can list hundreds of thousands of pages, but CrUX only has data for pages with enough Chrome traffic, so a lower limit keeps the import quick.

name: keyPages
label: Key pages
help: Optional. Enter the full URL of each page you want to track closely, one per line, such as your home page, top landing pages and checkout. These appear on the **Key pages** dashboard and don't count toward **Maximum pages**.

name: competitors
label: Competitor websites
help: Optional. Enter the origin of each competitor website to benchmark against, one per line, with no path (e.g. https://www.competitor.com).

name: apiKey
label: Google API key
help: Enter an API key from a Google Cloud project with the Chrome UX Report API enabled.
